# ledger_deferral_plans (Data Source)

Lists deferral plans, active and undone, optionally filtered, in identifier (creation) order. Every page is read. The live state of each plan is derived by Ledger on every read; see the `ledger_deferral_plan` data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every active plan whose planned date is in September 2026.
data "ledger_deferral_plans" "september" {
  state         = "active"
  planned_month = "2026-09"
}

output "september_planned" {
  value = [for p in data.ledger_deferral_plans.september.items : "${p.outstanding_amount} ${p.currency} on ${p.planned_date}"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `commitment_id` (String) Only plans of this commitment's occurrences.
- `occurrence_id` (String) Only plans of this occurrence.
- `planned_month` (String) Only plans whose planned date is in this month, YYYY-MM.
- `state` (String) Only plans in this state: active or undone.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The matching plans. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `adjustment_total` (String) The adjustments not removed, paid ones included, an exact decimal string in currency.
- `adjustments` (Attributes List) Every adjustment, oldest first, removed ones included (they are history). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--adjustments))
- `commitment_id` (String) The commitment the occurrence belongs to.
- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `currency` (String) The occurrence's ISO 4217 currency. Nothing is converted.
- `grace_until` (String) The planned date of an active documented_grace plan, otherwise null.
- `id` (String) The Ledger identifier (a ULID).
- `missed` (Boolean) True while the plan is active, its planned date has passed and the occurrence is overdue and still owes something, or a recorded fee is still planned. Derived on every read and not payment state.
- `missed_reason` (String) principal (the occurrence still owes something; takes precedence) or fee (a recorded fee is still planned), or null when not missed.
- `occurrence_id` (String) The occurrence the plan defers.
- `occurrence_status` (String) The occurrence's payment status today (paid, partially_paid, upcoming, due, overdue, not_recorded or cancelled). Derived on every read from payment evidence and dates; a plan never changes it.
- `original_amount` (String) The occurrence's amount when the plan was made, an exact decimal string in currency (history).
- `original_due_date` (String) The occurrence's due date when the plan was made (history).
- `outstanding_amount` (String) What the occurrence still owes today, an exact decimal string in currency. Derived on every read.
- `outstanding_when_planned` (String) What the occurrence still owed when the plan was made, an exact decimal string in currency (history).
- `overdue_since` (String) The occurrence's current due date while it is overdue, otherwise null. A plan never moves it.
- `plan_type` (String) personal, creditor_agreed or documented_grace.
- `planned_date` (String) The date the payment is planned, YYYY-MM-DD.
- `planned_month` (String) The month of planned_date, YYYY-MM: where the outstanding amount is planned.
- `reason` (String) Why, or null.
- `state` (String) active, or undone (ended and never changing again; kept as history).
- `undone_at` (String) When it was undone (RFC 3339, UTC), or null while active.
- `unpaid_adjustment_total` (String) The adjustments still planned (neither removed nor marked paid), an exact decimal string in currency.
- `updated_at` (String) When it last changed (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `version` (Number) The plan's version; it moves with every write to the plan, adjustments included.
- `within_grace` (Boolean) True while the occurrence is overdue and today is not after grace_until (overdue, within documented grace).

<a id="nestedatt--items--adjustments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.adjustments`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (String) The charge, an exact decimal string in currency.
- `created_at` (String) When it was recorded (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `currency` (String) The ISO 4217 currency of amount.
- `id` (String) The adjustment's Ledger identifier.
- `kind` (String) fee, interest or other.
- `note` (String) The note, or null.
- `paid_at` (String) When the person marked it paid, or null while planned. Never payment evidence for the occurrence.
- `paid_via` (String) session, token, mcp or system, or null.
- `removed_at` (String) When it was removed (RFC 3339, UTC), or null. A removed adjustment does not count.
